Our selling process

How to sell your home, step by step.

Selling a home can feel overwhelming. It doesn't have to. Here's exactly what happens when you list with our team — and what you'll be asked to do along the way.

Nadine to review wording & timing of each step

  1. Your consultation

    We meet at your home, walk through it together and listen: your goals, your timeline, your next move and any concerns.

    YouShare what matters most and show us what makes your home special.
    WeAnswer your questions and explain how the process works.

  2. Pricing strategy

    We study recent sales and current competition near you and recommend a price with the reasoning laid out plainly.

    YouReview the numbers and choose your list price.
    WePrepare a detailed market analysis for your home.

  3. Preparing your home

    Simple, practical recommendations to help your home show at its best — often small changes that make a real difference.

    YouTackle the to-do list at your own pace.
    WeSchedule photography and prepare your marketing.

  4. Launch & showings

    Your home goes live with its full marketing package. We coordinate showings and share buyer feedback with you as it comes in.

    YouKeep the home show-ready and approve showing times.
    WeManage showings, follow up with agents and keep you updated.

  5. Offers & negotiation

    We review every offer with you — not just the price, but the terms, financing and contingencies — and negotiate on your behalf.

    YouDecide which offer to accept.
    WeExplain each option and negotiate the best terms.

  6. Under contract to closing

    Inspections, appraisal, paperwork and deadlines: we keep everything on track and tell you what's coming next, all the way to the closing table.

    YouPlan your move.
    WeCoordinate with the buyer's agent, lender and title company.
